gate: docs/readiness/2026-09-08-agent-system-episode-and-core-pressure-v1.md section 8: every harness module -- a planner rule, an observe mode, a knowledge view, a judge, a tool -- carries a per-carrier admission receipt before it may enter the default plan. The contrast is module ON versus module OFF in the same harness on the same roster (one config key, never a second code path), paired with the carrier's cluster structure, n >= 400, cluster bootstrap, CI90; the guard is non-inferiority with the margin taken from the carrier's own null (family rule of 2026-09-08).
note: This table is a LIVING RECEIPT and it is opened with exactly the one module this note had the authority to decide. The other first entries listed in the design note's section 8 are not transcribed here: each needs its own decided row and its own evidence pin, and copying them in from a prose table would manufacture receipts that no verdict issued.

status_values.ADMITTED: a gain on the carrier's primary metric, disjoint from the carrier's own null, with every gating guard non-inferior at the measured margin
status_values.HARMFUL: a gating guard fails; stays in the record as a documented negative and never enters a plan
status_values.NEUTRAL: no harm and no gain; may enter the default plan

evidence.guards: corpus WER UB -0.02936 <= +0.05793; numeric-value accuracy (call-pooled) LB -0.02122 >= -0.15651; over-generation UB +0.00255 <= +0.02218; delivery integrity 0 violations on 1,593 windows; the semantic high-impact guard stays advisory because its own null excludes zero. Every gating guard passes under both weightings.

margins_from.note: the margins are that cell's own measured call-clustered CI90 half-widths; the over-generation margin was computed from its per-window rows through the same instrument and is anchored against its published corpus-WER interval

evidence.primary: PERSON entity WER reduction, call-clustered CI90, 44 call clusters, 1,593 paired 90-second windows: +3.737 [+2.653, +4.855] against the sealed comparator and +3.840 [+2.752, +4.958] against the token-matched twin; disjoint from the carrier's own PERSON null interval [-0.24338, +0.25680], 10.61 null half-widths at the lower bound
